**Visual observations:**
- Leaves showing general yellowing/chlorosis, especially on lower/older leaves
- Scattered small dark spots (black/dark brown) across the leaf surfaces
- Mix of green and yellow leaves on the same plant
- Spots appear small, irregular, and numerous

**Analysis:**
- The combination of leaf yellowing + small dark spots is characteristic of **Septoria brown spot** in soybeans, which causes small irregular brown-to-black lesions with yellow halos and progressive lower-leaf chlorosis/defoliation
- Bacterial Blight would show more angular water-soaked lesions
- Cercospora would show larger, more defined circular spots with purple borders
- The pattern here — numerous tiny dark lesions on yellowing leaves — fits Septoria well
